title: opro: upstream policy port
note: Delayed platform-measured study-feedback port; not native reproduction. See methods/policy_ports/README.md for per-method mechanisms and differences.

preserved: Accumulate every platform-measured instruction; stable global-best selection; ascending thresholded history, novelty filtering and multiple candidate proposals.
adapted: Platform measures candidates between external-method calls; only adaptation-visible study channel is read.
Candidate trees are staged artifacts; historical parents are restored from platform states.
missing_until_runtime_support: Native within-call evaluator callbacks and separate dev capability; no held-out score or gold exposure.
Optimizer JSON instruction protocol replaces native INS tags; evidence contains no reference answers.

deviations.what: Method evaluation callbacks are replaced by delayed platform measurements.
deviations.why: INTERFACE.md §4 prohibits a method from evaluating benchmark tasks. The bridge reads only staged study records and returns whole candidates; it never invents a dev fitness or evaluates a held-out task.

deviations.what: Optimizer JSON instruction protocol replaces native INS tags; evidence contains no reference answers.
deviations.why: The source strategy and prompts are pinned under methods/policy_ports/vendor; README maps each source stage to this runtime and declares every unavailable stage.
